tool_calls.literal:
/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '[.value, .stack_frames[]] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{for(i=2;i<=NF;i++) s["'$i]+=$1} END {for(k in s) print s[k], k}'"' | sort -nr | head -40
jq -s '{rows:length, positive_rows:map(select(.value>0))|length, negative_rows:map(select(.value<0))|length, positive_total:map(select(.value>0)|.value)|add, negative_total:map(select(.value<0)|.value)|add, sessions:(map(.labels.source_session[0])|unique|length)}' samples.jsonl
sed -n '1,200p' README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '[.value, (.stack_frames[]|select(startswith(\"result:\")))] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{if("'$1>0)p[$2]+=$1; else n[$2]+=-$1} END {for(k in p) printf "%d'"\\t%d\\t%+d\\t%s\\n\",p[k],n[k],p[k]-n[k],k; for(k in n) if("'!(k in p)) printf "0'"\\t%d\\t%d\\t%s\\n\",n[k],-n[k],k}' | sort -t "'$'"'\\t' -k3,3nr | head -25
jq -r 'select(any(.stack_frames[]; .==\"result:repeated\")) | [.labels.source_session[0], .value] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{if("'$2>0){p+=$2; ps[$1]=1}else{n+=-$2;ns[$1]=1}} END {for(k in ps)pc++;for(k in ns)nc++;printf "bad_count=%d good_count=%d excess=%d bad_sessions=%d good_sessions=%d'"\\n\",p,n,p-n,pc,nc}'
jq -r 'select(any(.stack_frames[]; .==\"result:repeated\")) | [.value, (.stack_frames[]|select(startswith(\"action:\")))] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{if("'$1>0)p[$2]+=$1;else n[$2]+=-$1}END{for(k in p)printf "%d'"\\t%d\\t%+d\\t%s\\n\",p[k],n[k],p[k]-n[k],k}' | sort -t "'$'"'\\t' -k3,3nr | head -20"
